narrative: Cobot's second-gen Proxie ships subscription-priced, its proof points audited operating hours from real customer sites rather than pilots, launched inside an Automate floor whose dominant theme is humanoids moving from research to commercial deployment. That is the operator-led, real-site backdrop in which captive fleets converting their own operations into paid deployment stay ahead of merchant humanoid sales.
remaining_gap: Proxie is a wheeled cobot and the pavilion is exhibition presence; no captive in-house humanoid fleet has been shown leading paid humanoid deployment.
